`group_actor.json` is a capture. The documents a Mobilizon group sends and serves about its members (members collection and pages, Member, Join, Accept, Leave, Remove, Update) are built by `test/support/mobilizon_shapes.ex`, each citing the Mobilizon source (commit f2590486f) its shape comes from.

The Event captures (`event-banner-nolocation.json`, `group-event-place.json`, `group-event-address-in-name.json`) are from the Yonder repository: see `../gancio/README.md`.
